title: Sums Up 2020!
text: Sums Up 2020!. This is a light weight, rubbery material ornament. It wasn't what I was expecting at all. With that being said, I think it's kind of cute and it definitely sums up 2020. There are 4 figures on mine with a little bit of space to personalize them on the hats. I haven't personalized them yet, but I plan to use a fine tip permanent marker as I have done on other ornaments and I don't foresee any problems. Each of the characters is wearing a face mask. The first zero in 2020 is a red covid symbol. The second zerio is a roll of toilet paper. Then there is also a bottle of hand sanitizer. It comes with a plain red ribbon to hang it. I do like it, but I wish it was made from a sturdier and nicer material.
